The system is an agricultural advisory tool, a sector system, not AI for general administration.

facts.fact: UNIMA says an AI-enabled agrometeorological advisory system for farmers and extension workers, built with the Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services and the Ministry of Agriculture, went through expert review in Liwonde and then controlled pretesting in Machinga District.

systems.owner: UNIMA with DCCMS and Ministry of Agriculture

facts.fact: The University of Malawi says it leads development and validation of an AI model for an agrometeorological advisory system under the NORAD-backed ARCS initiative, which was in expert review and farmer pretesting in September 2026.

MWI.note: No online government service portal is described.
